notes.title: Bug Fixes + Stability Improvements
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your patience with the version 2.0 release. Some players reported issues that were extremely difficult to reproduce leading to a long delay in releasing a fix. I sincerely apologize for this - none of our windows machine could reproduce the error which I was convinced had something to do with save state upgrades to 2.0 but turns out had a different cause entirely. As a result, this turned into a bit of a wild goose chase on my part and a solution was found only through the help of two devoted players; Ernesto E. and Damien E. (the latter of whom deserves special recognition as it was his insight that led to the fix). 

Changes are listed below. If you were impacted by either of these issues (or any others) please email us at info@cinqmarsmedia.org so we can do our best to make it up to you. 



Fixed gray screen issue at startup related to Vue library affecting certain windows builds / graphics setups. 

Fixed issue with learn & earn not persisting in certain cases

Various other modest stability improvements 

Upgrade to slightly newer framework



Thank you again for all your support and gracious understanding while bugs are ironed out from this new version.

notes.title: Version 2.0: Intraday! + New Game
notes.notes:
I'm so pleased to share with you a long overdue major update to Trade Bots. New features include: 

Intraday Trading (hourly) in an overhauled Crypto Mode. (*You will need to restart the crypto campaign). 

Custom Trendlines: By request, you can now unlock the ability to draw your own trendlines in the campaign. 

Sentiment Indicator: We have integrated a new indicator that is a measurement of news sentiment that is also accessible to bots

Updated Data -- consolidated for all modes through June 2025 (including intraday for crypto). 

We've also incorporated several other stability improvements by request: 

Game resets now preserves earned funds - if a bug is encountered, there is now a way to keep your progress while still resetting game data. 

Revamped brushing and more efficient chart drawing

Google Translate integration in external links

Modest performance enhancements with electron GPU acceleration

Ultra wide monitor support

Removed YouTube videos from Learn & Earn now auto-heal

A bug breaking ETF mode for some users now patched

Misc other bug fixes from discord + community hub

Thank you for all those who have remained patient and supported our non-profit's efforts. I desperately wish our volunteers had more time to post updates more frequently as we so love and appreciate the community that has grown around this game. The previous version (1.5) is still available by changing "version" in the settings. 



While enjoying the new update, please check out our newest project, a math game called "Equate 8". 

The free demo is available here: Equate 8 Demo

notes.title: Version 1.5 w/ New Features + New Game!
notes.notes:
We're excited to share with you version 1.5 of Trade Bots! Here's what's new:


 Updated price data for all assets through mid-2024
 A new difficulty setting (unlocked at a net worth milestone) called "Tax Mode". This siphons up to 37% every 365 days based on realized gains.
 In-game bot sharing! (more below)
 Newly compiled with the latest frameworks for some stability and performance improvements. 

So the #1 most requested feature on discord was the wish for a centralized forum for users to share bot creations. After some brainstorming, it seemed to make the most sense to add this directly into the game itself, under the "port" menu in the bot editor. Here you can share your bot with others (along with notes explaining your process) and browse the creations of other players. Bots can be up and down voted once by each player and are sorted based on their ratio of up votes and down votes (and whether the creator has reached a milestone that puts them in the top 1% of players). 

In other news, we just released a new game, CrossAbout. As always, thank you for your feedback and support of our non-profit and helping us do what we love most. And check out our newest project, it's free to play! 

[previewyoutube=ouI_LztDo3E;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Version 1.2.1: New Features Along With Performance Enhancements + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Our team has been hard at work improving the game and really appreciate all the collaborative feedback we've been getting in discord and on the community page! We're excited to announce a few new additions to the project: 


 Revamped Trade Node: You can now hit the "gear" icon in the trade node and have the option to input a constant or relative amount variably. Super cool idea by @rocketorbit on discord that expands a lot of possibilities for algorithmic bots. 
 Simple + Node Bots will now intelligently "await" data that is not yet available. For example, if you use a 200 day period for an indicator but the stock is just beginning and there aren't enough data points to satisfy the indicator, the bot will auto-pause until such a time as data becomes available. (although this behavior can be changed using the gear icon)
 Re-tooled upgrade system where automation milestones are now permanent. We realized we needed to provide some scaffolding to players so that once they reach a particular milestone, they can use a tool like limit trading or simple bots when needing to restart. (thank you @Valek + @Johnny Gueggu!) The upgrade tree will likely need further polish after this major change, so the games pacing/balance might be a bit off. Let us know your thoughts!
 A banking tutorial has now been added to better explain the mechanic.
 The game should now run smoothly with net worth's in excess of 1e18 with no theoretical limit (we foolishly underestimated how much money some players could make with their bots (I'm lookin at you @torben). 
 More podcasts have been added as unlockable milestones.
 A fun little surprise for anyone who makes it to the "trillion club", involving openBB
 Lots and lots of bug fixes, helped significantly by @Lemrin, @torben and others. 


This has been an extremely edifying, humbling and rewarding experience thus far - it's the first time I can truly say I've felt I'm openly collaborating with a work of art. Super cool. Again, apologies for all the bugs - this game seems to draw them like light, in a way we really didn't anticipate. Thank you to everyone who has been diligently sending over their saves so we can debug them!

@karatesnoopy has some really great ideas in the discord for systemic changes to how the game works, would love to hear what people think of that. I also wrote a short piece about the origins behind the development of the game, you can read here.

Finally, this release coincides with major updates to two of our older titles, if you haven't already please check out Copy Editor and The Devil's Calculator. Free demos are available for both and feel free to hit me up on steam for a full version key!

Thanks so much.

notes.title: v1.1.2 - Major New Features + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Quants! 

Wow. It's been so wonderful chatting with so many of you on discord and using your feedback to make the game better. Here are some of the new features: 


 Scroll Wheel Brushing (you can now pan and zoom with the mouse or trackpad)
 Bulk Upgrading Button Added
 Bots can now use your "Last Buy/Sell" as a relative time interval
 Discord is now fully integrated within the game as a milestone
 Google Translate is now integrated within the game (this comes at a performance penalty if enabled)
 External Indicator Layouts are now unrestricted
 New Transaction History View
 A few more Podcasts were embedded (please let us know if there are particular podcasts on iHeart you would like added to the game in the future)
 The randomness of ending a stock is now relativized. 


More importantly, we fixed a whole lot of bugs dedicated players brought to our attention. We're so grateful for your help and understanding with all of this - in hindsight we should have released in Early Access and made use of the community to patch these bugs sooner. Our non-profit will not make that mistake again for our next release. That being said, all known issues (except for the few minor ones mentioned at the bottom of this announcement) have been rectified, in no particular order: 


 Tutorials would re-initiate after restart
 Set Var node lacked a trigger
 Spacebar exploit now throttled
 Recession hover events not registered
 SMA/EMA trash hidden between upgrades
 Tooltip issues
 Formatting adjusted for Negative Numbers
 New Stock button would do nothing
 Feedback button would be unresponsive
 Fees not reset properly between restarts
 Two fatal game loading errors
 Brush moves on sim instead of scaling on sim
 Margin Loan Minimum rate Locked at 5%
 Short position persistence issues
 Cancelling lim/stop orders with a short position would flip position
 SMA/EMA colors fixed
 Issues with switching modes
 Layout persistence of external indicators
 Leading Indicators would be hidden unless DXY was purchased


Phew. That's a lot. And it wouldn't have been possible to patch these if not for the community who really stepped up and sent us their save files and made bug reports. I'd like to especially thank:

@rocketorbit, @dertorm, @DrDerpenstein, @malestrom, @utility, Sveelen, bob-the-builder, Johnny Gueggu and SterlingH

A few minor issues yet to be addressed: 


 Windows icon is split in half if not pinned (this is an electron bug, trying to find a solution)
 Video rewatch exploit 
 New transaction view erroneously shows everything as a "buy"


We'll patch these shortly along with more fixes and updates. 

I did want to ask everyone about a suggestion someone had on the forum recently -> that automation upgrades (i.e. lim/stop, simple bots, visual bots and all their upgrades) persist through restarting runs. I kind of like this idea, and we could change the upgrade costs in these areas to make sure the balance of the game stays more or less the same. Interested to hear what you think! 

As always, shoot us an email or drop-in on discord (remember you can now do it in-game) and say hi! We'd love to hear from you. 

Thank you all so much for your continued support, it means the world to us. 

- Chris

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone! In the 48 hours since launch, the community really stepped up and helped identify a few debilitating bugs all related to the same general issue with the refactor of the new engine. We rushed to deliver a day one patch with 1.0.3 but that didn't address all the issues and even created a few new ones. With 1.0.4 we believe things are now relatively stable and we can't thank you enough for your support, patience and understanding. In addition to several miscellaneous bugs, the big things addressed in this new version: 


 Stepping while finishing a stock now works properly and doesn't break or recede back (the team and beta testers missed this since we all bought the simulation upgrade well before the first stock ended)
 Simulation Speed Upgrades now function as intended (a consequence of releasing 1.0.3 too quickly)
 YouTube Embeds have a contingency so videos that have been removed or taken down should now redirect to a fallback
 Linux Stability has been improved (issues with steam overlay)
 We have introduced a new "restitution" button in the menu on the main title screen that allows us to issue codes to provide anyone effected by these or other bugs in-game currency to compensate for lost gameplay
 Feedback button now appends your save state so we can reproduce bugs more quickly. 


The full version is now live with the 1.0.4 build, however the new version of the demo needs another couple hours before it will be set live. 

There may well be other bugs on the horizon, this game is of unprecedented complexity for our modest non-profit, but we're committed to fixing any issues that come up as quickly as we possibly can and we're so grateful to all of you for your support and understanding. 

Thanks!
- Chris

notes.title: Trade Bots 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
We're very excited to share with you all that Trade Bots will have its version 1.0 release on April 18th. We deeply appreciate your patience as we've been hard at work improving the game. We made the decision to completely refactor the simulation engine from the ground up, improving simulation speeds up to 20x. This is particularly useful in the late game, where speeds of over 1000 days/s is possible, even on legacy hardware. This total refactor did, of course, lead to a number of unexpected bugs that we're still trying to iron out in pre-release beta testing. 

We've also included the ability to listen, directly in-game, to a number of popular financial podcasts while you play. As you hit higher net worth milestones, more podcasts become available until ultimately you can select your own. 

Our non-profit has also settled on the price point of $12.99 (with a 15% launch discount). Determining a price point that reflects the magnitude of work and effort poured into the project while also trying to accommodate the most diverse audience possible is a very difficult balance, one we believe we struck. While this is our non-profit's most expensive game to-date, it has also been the most expensive and complex to develop by far, and we believe the quality of the product reflects that. 

Of course, we still plan on making the game freely available to teachers and students. This will be after the initial launch period so we can focus entirely on patching any bugs found by the community. The publish date for the site where students and teachers can redeem free codes will be announced within the first month of release. 

A few features will not make it into this initial release but will be added in (free) updates. These include: 


 Modular nodes in advanced bots (making your own nodes as nested sequences of other nodes)
 Paper / Backtesting modes in advanced bots
 Leaderboards
 Custom Data Import

We will note that neural networks and bot import/export features are in beta and that we also hope to integrate more features suggested by the community, as in my experience those tend to be the most rewarding and fruitful. 

Again, thank you for your patience and for making it possible for us to do what we're most passionate about, creating fun, engaging and educational games for all of you. Please reach out to us at info@cinqmarsmedia.org with any questions or just to say "hi". We'd love to hear from you. 

Thanks!
